decisions.text: arranged: columns by payment method, series in each panel by region: the insight compares region directly (facts.compare): drawn as series in each panel (RP3-4, G1.19); the panels facet on method; runner-up for review: rows by payment method, columns by region (D-38 (i))
each series its own colour, the same in every panel, handed out top to bottom by the line ends of the last panel: Central slot 1, West slot 2, North slot 3, East slot 4, Int'l slot 5 (G4.27, G7.50)
type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
one shared scale: one scale for every panel, so that sizes compare across panels (G7.48)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
the title wraps onto two lines
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
the unit phrase on the top label: “$60K in donations”; the top gridline starts after it
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$60K in donations”
time axis: row 1 full, every third label, restarting in each group
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: East moved 0.32 line heights, North moved 0.34 line heights
1 × 3 panels of equal size, abutting, divided by light separators, no box round a panel (G7.51); each 104 pt wide and 155 pt high
scale labels left of the first column, the unit phrase once on the first row's top label; time labels only under the bottom row; column headers above the top row (G7.49)
each series labelled once, at its line's end right of the last panel (G5.15, D-38 (iii))

source.shows: the other intermediate arrangement: the insight compares regions, so the five regions share each payment method's panel and the methods become a row of three panels on one scale; the regions labelled once, at their lines' ends right of the last panel, as the book does (G5.15, D-38 (iii))

summary.arrangement: columns by payment method, series in each panel by region
